purpose: Synthetic Monte Carlo only; no medical evidence, no DP noise, no AdamW utility inference.

families.prediction: Pilot two equal discrete samples produce zero variance half the time; diagnostic of v0 blindness, not selected after results.
Directional allocation opportunity beyond budgets near four; finite pilot/floor/cap can still prevent gain.
J identity mostly; geometry has no special advantage over raw variance.
Boundary guard matters; Jacobian approximation is not an exact MSE model.
No population heterogeneity; pilot overhead and random R should lose to good fixed R.
Same total variance but different tangent variance; correlation and pilot direction error may hurt geometry.
Large perturbations invalidate small-error justification; noise-dominant refers MC noise, not added DP Gaussian noise.

allocation.geometry_proxy: raw if |norm(pmean)-C| <= kappa*sqrt(raw); else J at pmean, identity inside, projected C/norm outside
allocation.controller: R=smallest allowed level >= min(16,max(1,sqrt(proxy/lambda))); zero proxy -> R=1
allocation.lambda_calibration: Independent public synthetic calibration. Bisection selects largest expenditure not exceeding target total mean cost if attainable; report quantized slack. No test scores used.
allocation.final_draws: Fresh independent of both pilot gradients and lambda calibration; within a test replicate common final draw bank across methods.

comparators: raw-variance v0 with same two pilot draws
public-calibration best randomized fixed-R policy matched to each adaptive calibration cost; report test realized mismatch
finite-risk oracle by known type from independent calibration MSE curves, with and without charged two-draw overhead; diagnostic only
oracle_and_fixed_policy: Enumerate deterministic R pair (oracle type-aware) or single fixed R. Select convex mixture of at most two policies minimizing calibration mean clipped MSE subject expected cost <= cap. Random mixture independent of all pilot/final draws and labels. No test tuning.
outputs: per-family/method/budget clipped MSE, MC SE, actual cost, R frequency, guard rate
paired test MSE differences versus calibration-selected matched fixed mixture, with 95% MC interval (not patient or medical CI)
preclip mean error vector/norm and coordinate z diagnostics plus conditional-expectation identity
all fixed curves and oracle bounds
no_posthoc_rescue: After results no changes to kappa/C/families/R/seed; preserve failures. No chosen-best medical claims.
scope: Users are two equally weighted synthetic gradient distributions. Privacy accountant is not run. Variable compute is only an internal cost count; no walltime/privacy guarantee established.
code_binding: Execution will hash protocol plus exact script before calculation and preserve immutable result artifacts.
